nis2_gaps: NIS2 Art. 21 §2(e): Substandard RSA key length (2048 bits < 3072 bits transitional threshold)
nis2_actions: Upgrade RSA certificate to minimum 3072-bit or adopt ML-DSA-65
regulatory_compliance.nis2_penalty: Up to EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of annual worldwide turnover (NIS2 Art. 34)
dora_gaps: DORA Art. 9 §4: Legacy RSA-2048 key does not guarantee long-term operational resilience
dora_actions: Rotate certificates to PQC-ready hybrid or 4096-bit RSA immediately
regulatory_compliance.dora_penalty: Periodic penalty payments up to 1% of average daily worldwide turnover (DORA Art. 50)
bsi_gaps: BSI TR-02102-2: RSA-2048 is deprecated beyond 2024

vulnerabilities.description: Server certificate uses RSA 2048-bit public key. Factorable via Shor's algorithm on a quantum computer with ~4096 logical qubits, allowing adversary impersonation, rogue certificate creation, and MITM.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Transition to dual-certificate configuration supporting NIST FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 signatures
